en.headline: Chan says August exports up 53 percent on AI demand, GDP goal in reach
en.dek: The Financial Secretary wrote that overall merchandise exports reached HK$667.9 billion last month and the government remains confident of 3.5 to 4.5 percent growth for the year.
body: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said Hong Kong's overall merchandise exports rose 53 percent year on year in August to HK$667.9 billion, driven by demand for artificial intelligence and related electronic products.

In his weekly blog published on Sunday, Chan noted that the combined export value for the first eight months of 2026 was 42.5 percent higher than the same period last year. On the latest assessment by the Government Economist, he said the administration is confident of meeting the revised full-year GDP growth forecast of 3.5 to 4.5 percent.

Chan added that AI also brings governance challenges. He said Hong Kong can offer trusted solutions in model training, cross-border data flows, privacy protection and dispute resolution, drawing on its common-law system, bilingual and trilingual legal talent, internationally connected standards and professional services.

The government is supporting wider AI literacy through the All-Community AI programme, which is to launch more than 200 training courses and activities by the first quarter of 2028, and an AI skills enhancement scheme expected to benefit at least 40,000 employees.

zh.headline: 陳茂波：8月出口升53% AI需求帶動 有信心達GDP目標
zh.dek: 財政司長在網誌指整體商品出口貨值達6,679億元，首八個月升42.5%，政府有信心全年經濟增長3.5%至4.5%。
body: 財政司長陳茂波表示，受人工智能及相關電子產品需求帶動，本港8月整體商品出口貨值達6,679億元，按年上升53%。
他在周日發表的網誌指出，今年首八個月合計出口貨值按年上升42.5%。按政府經濟顧問最新評估，當局有信心達到全年本地生產總值增長3.5%至4.5%的經修訂預測目標。
陳茂波又指，人工智能同時帶來治理挑戰。香港可憑藉普通法制度、兩文三語法律人才、連通國際的標準與專業服務，在模型訓練、數據跨境、私隱保護及糾紛處理等方面，提供各方信任的解決方案。
政府正推動「全民AI」普及計劃，至2028年首季將推出超過200項培訓課程和活動；AI技能提升計劃預計惠及至少四萬名僱員。
